nika: Heads-up: overnight we flipped default routing to v2 for 'general' routes and a subset of customers reported unexpected cost deltas. Request: can we design an "account-level" pin flow vs the current per-route pin?
marco: saw the spike. Most impacted tenants have many small routes and batch jobs; pinning every route is tedious. account-level pin would be faster but riskier (broader surface).
joy: proposal: pin layers -> ephemeral quick-pin (1h/12h), route-pin, account-pin, and policy-pin (org policy enforced). Console should show which layer applied and why.
infra-bot: auto: alert annotated: affected_accounts=9, avg_token_increase_p95=32%, top_cause=batch_reencode
rita: UX concern: account-pin could hide that some routes are fine on v2. Need console drilldown that highlights exceptions so SREs can unpin specific routes after account-pin. Also require an audit note on any account-pin.
marco: operationally, account-pin API might look like: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/account/pin \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"account":"edgeco","pin":{"version":"v1","expires":"12h","reason":"cost-spike-2024-10-12","scope":"account"}}'
```
joy: add safeguards: 1) require role `pin:emergency` for quick-pin; 2) default TTL 12h for quick-pin; 3) pin provenance metadata (who/why/auto) surfaced in console and in metrics.
nika: telemetry: we need pre/post token delta by account, pinned_scope, and session_affinity status. Also surface `connection_drain_remaining` so teams know when v2 workers will finish existing sessions.
marco: note: pin does not immediately rebind live connections because of worker affinity. We should expose an action "flush-affinity" that can be invoked per-pool with warning: increased latency.
rita: UI mock: create a compact account-pin banner with CTA: "Pin account -> choose scope (all routes / only background jobs / specific tags)". Add a checkbox: "suppress live flush (recommended)".
product-sam: policy ask: auto-pinning when projected_token_delta>threshold? We could add an opt-in policy that auto-applies ephemeral account-pin and notifies billing + owner. Thoughts?
joy: auto-pin is tempting but dangerous; require owner-ack and 2-step confirmation for account-level auto-pin. For route-level auto-pin allow single-step.
infra-bot: auto: suggestion: add metric `pin_cost_avoidance_estimate` and emit when pin applied.
nika: runbook items: 1) detect candidate accounts via sampling (seq_len_p95 + token_rate). 2) apply ephemeral pin via API. 3) wait for connection_drain_remaining==0 or call flush-affinity. 4) monitor pre/post token metrics for 30m. 5) if cost reduction < 20% revert and file a bug.
marco: I'll add CLI and console links to the runbook and a one-click rollback button.
rita: small follow-up: show pin history timeline per-account in console so we can correlate billing anomalies with pins.
product-sam: approved: add 'pin provenance' telemetry and a GA ticket to evaluate auto-pin policy in next quarter.
infra-bot: auto: follow-up reminder scheduled in 1h.
